summary:
Frontend-only verification of iteration 63 (Aufmassprofi /sketches/draw) features: (A) Undo button [data-testid=line-measure-undo] in the line-measure panel, (B) shared sound toggle [data-testid=line-laser-sound-toggle] / [data-testid=arrow-laser-sound-switch] with AsyncStorage key 'aufmassprofi_laser_sound', (C) selected polygon segment highlight in red-orange #FF3D00 with #fff white outline. Route to panel used (works, same as iter 62): localhost 768x1024, click 'Ich habe die Hinweise gelesen' + 'App starten' + 'Überspringen', click 25 px above toolbar label 'Polygon' (polyline tool, icon git-network-outline), draw rectangle (200,350)(500,350)(500,600)(200,600) + close click (205,355) with ≥320 ms between clicks, click 25 px above label 'Edit' then click segment midpoint (350,350).

VERIFIED (10/12):
1) Panel at 768x1024: 4 chips present with the requested testIDs in a 2x2 grid, each 90.5x44 px, no overlap. Row 1: line-auto-add-toggle @ (561,261) 'Laser sofort übernehmen | AUS', line-auto-next-toggle @ (658,261) 'Nächste Linie | AUS'. Row 2: line-laser-sound-toggle @ (561,311) 'Ton | AUS', line-measure-undo @ (658,311) 'Zurück'. Rest of panel intact (input placeholder 'z.B. 2,50m oder Text', S/M/L + ABC chips, numpad 0–9/m/cm/',' /- /backspace, Fläche chip, Maßlinien-Darstellung disclosure, Cancel + Done at bottom).
2) Panel at 390x844: same 4 testIDs present, each 75x44 px, two rows (y=249 and y=299), no overlap, modal fits, Done/Cancel reachable. Labels 'Laser sofort übernehmen' and 'Ton' get truncated to 'Laser sofort ...' and 'T...' because numberOfLines={1} on 'Ton' + narrower 75 px chips at phone width (minor design nit — see design_issues).
3) Highlight: after tapping the top segment, exactly one red line with stroke=#FF3D00 and one underlay with stroke=#fff is rendered (SVG strokes dump: ['#333','#FF5722','rgba(100,100,100,0.4)','#FF0000','#fff','#FF3D00']). The highlight moves to the next segment after add (observed x1=500,y1=155,x2=500,y2=405 = right side) and disappears when the panel closes (no #FF3D00 stroke after panel auto-close).
4) Undo disabled initially (aria-disabled=true, computed opacity=0.4) when the panel is first opened on a fresh polygon.
5) Nächste Linie AN, add 2.91m + Add (via 'Add' button detected by inner-text): segment 1 labeled '2.91m', selection auto-advances to segment 2 (red highlight moves), Undo becomes enabled (aria-disabled=None, opacity=1). Add 3.62m: labels=['2.91m','3.62m','S1']. Press Zurück → labels=['2.91m','S1'], panel STILL OPEN (text 'Enter measurement' still in DOM), red highlight returned to segment 2. Press Zurück again → labels=[], Undo back to disabled (opacity 0.4, aria-disabled=true).
6) BOTH toggles ON (AWAITED clicks; verified AN text and localStorage: aufmassprofi_line_auto_add='1', aufmassprofi_line_auto_next='1', aufmassprofi_laser_sound='1'): four fast bursts via page.keyboard.type delay=5: '2.91m','3.62m','2.91m','3.62m' with 900 ms waits → labels on SVG=['2.91m','3.62m','2.91m','3.62m','S1','10,53 m²'], panel auto-closed after burst 4 ('Enter measurement' NOT in DOM). This completes the scenario iter 62 could not directly observe.
7) After-close undo: reopened right segment (500,475), Undo enabled → Zurück removes '3.62m' from seg 2 (labels=['2.91m','3.62m','2.91m','S1']); subsequent burst '7.77m' refills seg 2 → labels=['2.91m','3.62m','2.91m','7.77m','S1','15,12 m²'].
8) Overwrite undo (390x844): apply '2,00m' → reopen same segment → placeholder reads 'Aktuell: 2,00m' (previous value exposed) → apply '5,00m' → reopen a DIFFERENT segment → press Zurück → labels=['2,00m','S1'] i.e. the segment shows the restored '2,00m' (not deleted). Spec line passes.
9) Sound toggle on the chip: clicking line-laser-sound-toggle switches AUS→AN WITHOUT crash/red screen, state becomes AN, aufmassprofi_laser_sound='1'. Fast bursts with Ton AN produced no page error and no console error. Note on web: expo-audio may log/silently fail on first user-gesture; no errors captured in console during the test. Actual audibility CANNOT be verified in automation.
10) Persistence: set aufmassprofi_laser_sound='1' via setItem, reloaded the page, dismissed disclaimer/tour again; the key value survives (still '1' after reload). Note: aufmassprofi_line_auto_add / aufmassprofi_line_auto_next are only written when the user toggles (default-off branch does not write), so after a fresh reload those keys are observed as null — this matches the default-off behavior described in spec but means persistence of those two keys is only testable AFTER a user toggle; a fresh-reload-with-null still produces chip 'AUS' which is correct.
11) Regression (768x1024): Cancel button, Done button, area chip (Fläche m² — alle Seiten bemaßen), S/M/L + ABC chips, numpad digits/m/cm/','/'-'/backspace, Maßlinien-Darstellung disclosure all render and tap without error. Overview shows 'S1 = 13,06 lfm • 10,53 m²' after full measurement. No console errors, no React Native red screen, app loads normally with newly-installed expo-audio.

NOT DIRECTLY OBSERVED IN AUTOMATION (2/12):
- arrow-laser-sound-switch reflecting the same laserSound state inside the Bemaßungspfeil modal on 390x844: automated clicks on the 'Measure Line' toolbar label (the arrow/Bemaßungspfeil tool) did not succeed on 390x844 (label at x=424 is horizontally scrolled off-screen) nor on 768x1024 (icon is above and centered at a slightly different x than the label; my (labelCenter, labelY-25) target landed in a neighboring icon). Static code review CONFIRMS correct wiring: line 832 declares `const [laserSound, setLaserSound]` and line 7726 (chip) uses `changeLaserSound` while line 8229 uses `<Switch testID="arrow-laser-sound-switch" value={laserSound} onValueChange={changeLaserSound} />` – the chip and modal switch are bound to the SAME state + setter, so they are guaranteed to be in sync at render time. A quick manual tap on the arrow tool would complete this verification.
- Undo after the polygon has been deleted: not reached in automation (requires opening the panel while an element is selected, deleting the polygon via the trash button mid-panel, which closes the panel; the undo button lives inside the panel so the 'disabled after deletion' check is only reachable if the panel is re-opened on another element after deletion). The code at draw.tsx:843-848 guards exactly this: `const last = [...lineMeasureHistory].reverse().find(h => elements.some(e => e.id === h.elementId)); if (!last) { setLineMeasureHistory([]); return; }` — so a stale history after deletion will not crash and will leave the button disabled on the next render.

Actual audibility of the laser-OK sound cannot be verified from browser automation. Haptics is a no-op on web (expo-haptics returns silently). expo-audio was successfully loaded (no module-resolution error on reload) and no console/pageerror events were emitted during fast bursts with Ton AN.

issues: Chip label 'Ton' has numberOfLines={1} but the chip is only 75 px wide on 390x844 so the icon + 'Ton' + 'AUS' badge fit together and the second-row left chip actually shows 'T... AUS' (middle label truncated to a single character). Suggest shortening the badge or hiding the volume icon on the smallest viewport, or widening the chip to full-row width when there are only 2 items in that row. Minor cosmetic — does not affect function.

Chip label 'Laser sofort übernehmen' similarly displays as 'Laser sofort ...' at 390x844 (carried over from iter 62). Iter 62 already suggested shortening to 'Laser übernehmen' or reducing fontSize — still applies.

test_report_links: Inline Playwright scripts executed via browser_automation. Repro steps identical to iter 62 context_for_next_testing_agent, plus for iter 63: enable both chips via AWAITED `.click(force=True)`, pre-seed localStorage with `setItem('aufmassprofi_laser_sound','1')` then `page.reload()` + redo disclaimer/tour, to verify persistence.

Screenshots: /tmp/iter63_panel.png (768x1024 panel with 4 chips), /tmp/iter63_undo_done.png (after 2x Zurück), /tmp/iter63_both_fourburst.png (4 labels + 10,53 m² area), /tmp/iter63_overwrite_undo.png (390x844 restore to 2,00m), /tmp/iter63_phone_panel.png (390x844 panel layout).
action_items: (Cosmetic only, not blocking) Shorten the chip labels 'Laser sofort übernehmen' and 'Ton' or widen the chips on small viewports so that at 390x844 the second-row 'Ton' chip no longer renders as 'T... AUS'. Code is at draw.tsx ~7700 and 7729.

(Optional) Give the arrow/Bemaßungspfeil toolbar button an explicit testID (e.g. testID='arrow-tool-button') so the next automation run can open the Bemaßungspfeil modal without relying on the ambiguous 'Measure Line' label (icon is not aligned exactly with the label on tablet and label scrolls off-screen on phone). This would allow the next agent to confirm the arrow-laser-sound-switch UI reflection automatically.
No production bug found — the 3 new features all function per spec in automation.
critical_code_review_comments: draw.tsx:843-863 undoLastLineMeasurement — correctly filters history by live elements, restores previous value if present else deletes, re-selects the segment, forces panel open via setShowLineMeasurementNumpad(true) and refocuses the input. Handles the 'polygon deleted' edge via elements.some(...) guard without crashing.

draw.tsx:1013-1020 addMeasurementToSelectedLine — appends history {elementId, segmentIndex, previous: lineSegmentMeasurements[el][seg]} BEFORE applying the new value, which is the correct order; `.slice(-49)` caps the history at 50 entries. Note the `previous` is read from the state closure (which is stale because the enclosing setState hasn't committed yet), but that's correct here: we want the value that existed BEFORE this add call, so the stale closure value is actually the right source.

draw.tsx:5324-5325 highlight uses TWO stacked <Line> elements, the outer white at strokeWidth+9 and the inner #FF3D00 at strokeWidth+5, giving the requested white outline around a red-orange line. Verified visually and by SVG stroke dump.

draw.tsx:832-839 laserSound state + changeLaserSound — AsyncStorage key 'aufmassprofi_laser_sound', writes on every toggle, idempotent, and plays playLaserFeedback() on the AUS→AN transition. Chip (line-laser-sound-toggle) and modal Switch (arrow-laser-sound-switch) share the same state variable and the same setter, so they are automatically in sync.

src/utils/laserFeedback.ts — createAudioPlayer with require('../../assets/sounds/laser-ok.wav'), setAudioModeAsync({playsInSilentMode:true, interruptionMode:'mixWithOthers'}), seekTo(0) then play(). Catches silently on error. expo-haptics uses NotificationFeedbackType.Success and is wrapped in try/catch. Correct for web (both become no-ops silently).

draw.tsx is now 9887 lines (grew 79 lines in this iter). Still violates >700-line guideline (same long-standing issue noted in iter 62). Not caused by this feature but splitting the line-measure panel + arrow modal into their own components is overdue.
The 'Add'/'Done' primary CTA at the bottom of the line-measure panel STILL has NO testID, which forces every automation to detect it by inner text. Suggest adding testID='line-measure-done-button'.

success_rate.frontend: 10 of 12 feature points directly verified in automation + 2 covered by static code review only (arrow modal Switch reflects same state; undo after polygon deletion). No blocking defect found.

seed_data_creation: None server-side. Browser-side localStorage keys aufmassprofi_sketch_tour_done='1', aufmassprofi_tour_done='1', aufmassprofi_disclaimer_accepted='1' (pre-seeded via init script in test A but subsequent tests dismissed the dialog manually because the init script was not consistently applied in time), and feature keys aufmassprofi_line_auto_add/aufmassprofi_line_auto_next/aufmassprofi_laser_sound set to '1' only in the dedicated tests. ProjectIds used: TEST_ITER63_C, TEST_ITER63_UNDO, TEST_ITER63_BOTH, TEST_ITER63_PH, TEST_ITER63_ARR5 (query-string only, no server round-trip observed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: To open the Bemaßungspfeil modal reliably: either add testID to the arrow toolbar button, or on 768x1024 click the icon at approximately (420, 91) — the 'M←→' bidirectional-arrow icon that sits ABOVE but slightly LEFT of the 'Measure Line' label (not centered on it). After the tool is selected, click two canvas points to place an arrow; the modal opens with testIDs 'arrow-auto-add-switch' and 'arrow-laser-sound-switch'. To test undo after polygon deletion: open the panel on a segment, enable 'Nächste Linie', add one measurement, then with the panel closed delete the polygon via the toolbar trash, then re-open the panel on any OTHER remaining polygon segment (if any) and confirm the Undo button renders as disabled (opacity 0.4, aria-disabled=true). The code path for this is draw.tsx:843-848. All other features from the spec were directly observed PASSING.
rca_of_issue: No blocking bug found. The two items not directly observed are automation-shortcomings on MY side (toolbar label scrolling off-screen at 390x844 and label-vs-icon horizontal offset at 768x1024), not product defects. Both are covered by static review of the identical shared-state code path (laserSound) and the explicit element-existence guard in undoLastLineMeasurement.
